def kernels(a):
    import numpy as n
    a = (a - a.mean(0)) / n.maximum(a.std(0), 0.04)
    M = a @ a.T / a.shape[1]
    dist = n.maximum(0, n.diag(M)[:, None] + n.diag(M)[None, :] - 2 * M)
    D = n.abs(a[:, None, :] - a[None, :, :])
    return {'linear': 1 + M, **{f'p{d}': (1 + M) ** d for d in [2, 3, 4]}, **{f'g{c}': 1 + M + n.exp(-dist * c) for c in [0.2, 1]}, **{f'a{c}': 1 + M + n.exp(-D ** 2 * c).mean(-1) for c in [0.5, 2, 7]}}
